name: Clicking a variant opens detail page with images, stats, and color filter

steps.description: Click the 'View Details' button for the first variant
steps.snapshotHint: Look for a button/link in the first variant row that says 'View Details' or has an eye icon

steps.script: (() => { const page = document.querySelector('body'); const text = page?.textContent || ''; return { hasStats: /selling.price|cost.price|stock|color/i.test(text), hasContent: text.length > 100 }; })()
steps.description: Variant detail page shows stats cards

businessContext: Variant detail shows all data for a product variant — images, stats, pricing
